description: Renew hosting +30 days for $1 USDC. Same claiming wallet (or editToken for a card-paid site). Allowed only while the site is live and remaining < 90 days (stacked cap 90). After expiry renew is unavailable — claim again as a new site; last day without renew means the site is deleted and the slug is free. Support: contact@sornkan.com. If you have no wallet, get payment_url from the 402 response and show it to the human — they pay by card or Thai PromptPay in THB (no crypto needed); after they pay, poll preview_status/retry until live.

editToken.description: Edit token of a site paid by card/PromptPay (shown once at claim and emailed to the payer). Required to edit/renew/connect a domain on such a site.

slug.description: Live site slug to renew — the {slug} in {slug}.worldsite.workers.dev
